title: Coordinator's wording for the roles-resume-by-name sentence, built on the guard's proxy.
ruling: Coordinator, 09:18 CST Nov 12 (not an owner ruling): 409 a's own words first ("Resume a finished agent by name, unless its worktree is gone."), then the guard's proxy ("A finished agent that ran in its own worktree, or a reviewer, has none: send a fresh agent of the same role the prior report."). Measured 09:17 CST in one container: 3 of 3 finished worktree agents had no tree left (small sample). The first sentence is not the words on the page for 409 a.
quote: Resume a finished agent by name, unless its worktree is gone.
